item.title: Woman who possessed bullet, attempted to make 3D-printed gun gets jail
item.description: Jermaine Lim posted an image of a 3D-printed gun on Instagram, the woman who made it received jail time. Jermaine Lim posted an image of the assembled gun on her Instagram story.

item.title: Trump Insists Cease-Fire Holds Despite Exchange of Fire
item.description: The United States attacked Iranian targets after strikes on American ships, despite a proposed peace plan. The United States said it had attacked Iranian military targets in response to strikes on American ships.

item.title: UAE reports drone and missile attack as Iran war ceasefire is challenged
item.description: The United Arab Emirates responded to missile and drone strikes from Iran, straining the ceasefire. The Iran war's shaky ceasefire was further strained on Friday as the United Arab Emirates responded to a missile and drone strikes.

item.title: U.S. and allies test capabilities near Asia's flash points
item.description: US and its allies tested new military tactics in the Philippines, including drone boats and long-range missiles, as tensions with China rise. The drills aim to sharpen deterrence in the region.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine accuse each other of breaching Victory Day ceasefire
item.description: Russia and Ukraine accused each other of breaching a ceasefire hours after it began, with both sides reporting hundreds of drone attacks. The truce was meant to cover Victory Day celebrations.

item.description: Spanish authorities are preparing to receive over 140 passengers and crew from a hantavirus-stricken cruise ship headed to the Canary Islands. The ship will dock in Spain for medical treatment and quarantine.

item.title: Old Hantavirus Tweet Goes Viral: Experts Warn Against Panic, See List Of Reliable Resources
item.description: Public health experts warn against panic over a viral hantavirus tweet, citing the spread of unverified medical information. Public health experts warn that such viral posts often spread faster than verified medical information.

item.title: Court Decision Leaves South Africa’s President Facing Impeachment Inquiry
item.description: Judges ruled President Cyril Ramaphosa should face an impeachment hearing over money stolen from his farm. Judges ruled that an impeachment hearing should be held over a case involving money stolen from a couch at President Cyril Ramaphosa’s farm six years ago.

item.title: China's Invisible Hand Is Rebalancing The Oil Market
item.description: China's commercial oil stocks are rising despite lower crude imports, affecting the oil market. China's commercial oil stocks are rising, not falling, despite lower crude imports. China's Invisible Hand Is Rebalancing The Oil Market.

item.title: US, Iran clash in Hormuz as war escalates: What happened, why it matters
item.description: The US and Iran have a ceasefire in place since April 8, but no peace deal has been agreed. A ceasefire between the US and Iran has been in place since April 8.

item.title: Taiwan Breaks Political Deadlock to Approve $25 Billion U.S. Arms Purchase
item.description: Taiwanese lawmakers approved $25 billion for a US arms purchase, fearing loss of support if they didn't act. With time running out, Taiwanese lawmakers approved funds for buying U. S. weapons, fearing they could lose support if they didn’t act now.

item.description: A hantavirus-hit cruise ship is heading to the Canary Islands, expected to reach Tenerife on Saturday or Sunday. The vessel is expected to reach the Spanish island of Tenerife, off the coast of West Africa, on Saturday or Sunday.

item.title: U.A.E. Expels Pakistani Workers, as Pakistan’s Peacemaking Creates a Rift
item.description: The UAE is expelling Pakistani workers as Pakistan's ties to the Emirates deteriorate. As Pakistan mediates between the U. S. and Iran, its ties to the Emirates have deteriorated. Pakistani workers say they are now being sent home en masse.
